title: Prescribed block types and abundance in bicolored Steiner triple systems
abstract: Four Lean results for bicolored Steiner triple systems. For each fixed number k >= 3 of color classes, sufficiently large compatible labelled profiles with positive class and type margins admit exact prescribed block-type counts while completing any sufficiently sparse allowed packing. Uniformly over such prescribed matrices, the logarithm of the number of realizations has optimal leading coefficient 1/6 in n squared times log n. For any fixed K, the same exact type matrix has K realizations with distinct Pasch counts. For every fixed k >= 4, all sufficiently large admissible orders admit a k-bicoloring. The final threshold is ineffective.
